content.short: Tangem Wallet is a hardware wallet that uses NFC cards or rings with a mobile app to secure TON and other crypto assets.
content.description: Tangem Wallet is a self custody hardware wallet system built around NFC enabled cards or rings paired with a mobile app. Users manage assets by tapping the device to their phone, which keeps private key control tied to physical hardware rather than a browser or hot wallet alone. Tangem supports sending, receiving, swapping, buying, and portfolio tracking across many assets, with TON included as part of its broader multi-chain coverage for people who want simpler hardware based account security and everyday spending access.
content.meta: Tangem Wallet combines NFC hardware and a mobile app to secure TON and other assets with self custody storage and daily wallet functions.

resources.title: How to Protect Your Crypto From Phishing Scams
resources.tldr: Phishing took over $1.8B in 2024, and almost none of it required breaking any cryptography. Runs through the actual vectors: cloned sites, Discord lures, malicious approvals.

resources.title: Is Self-Custody Risky? Understanding Crypto Self-Custody Risks
resources.tldr: Refuses the usual framing that self-custody is simply safer. Weighs the risks you take on against the ones you shed, then covers how to reduce the former.

resources.title: What Is a Hot Wallet?
resources.tldr: Being connected to the internet is the entire definition, and every tradeoff follows from it. A clean primer on where hot wallets fit and where they stop being appropriate.
